text.p: Following are the main stories in Thursday's Malaysian newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

-- Heavy vehicles will be banned from using the fast lane on the 900-km long North-South Expressway which stretches the length of Peninsular Malaysia to reduce accidents, said Transport Minister Ling Liong Sik.
-- Businessman Amin Shah Omar Shah has expanded his maritime empire with the 250 million ringgit purchase of Denmark's Danyard Shipyard.

-- Five government departments will stay open for 11 hours instead of just eight to increase efficiency, Finance Ministry Parliamentary Secretary Shafie Mohd Salleh told Parliament. These are the Immigration, Customs, National Registration, Road Transport and Public Services departments.
-- Sime Darby Bhd is negotiating to buy a controlling stake in Oriental Bank Bhd.
